  August 2026 = 8 items, unchanged, all previously reported.

harness-skills: AUDITED 2026-09-25. [REPORTED] Literal facts:
  * FOUR skill source types on the `skills` field: awsSkills | git | s3 | path.
  * skills settable at CreateHarness/UpdateHarness AND overridable per InvokeHarness;
    invoke-time appended AFTER create-time; on name collision INVOKE-TIME WINS.
  * git: any public OR private HTTPS repo, sparse-checkout subdir via `path`,
    auth.credentialArn -> token-vault apikeycredentialprovider holding a PAT,
    auth.username default "oauth2". 60s clone timeout. NAT gateway needed for egress.
    *** Git auth NOT supported on the `agentcore invoke --skills` override. ***
  * s3: execution role s3:GetObject + s3:ListBucket, <=1 GB per skill, works over S3 VPCe.
  * awsSkills: globs over AWS Agent Toolkit. Categories: core-skills/* (EC2,S3,Lambda,
    DynamoDB,CloudWatch,IAM), specialized-skills/analytics-skills/*, .../operations-skills/*,
    .../storage-skills/*. Relative paths only; ".." and absolute rejected.
  * path: baked into container image OR installed at session start via
    InvokeAgentRuntimeCommand (doc shows `git clone ... && cp -r ... .agents/skills/xlsx`).
  * Skill format = open AgentSkills.io spec: SKILL.md w/ YAML frontmatter (name,
    description) + optional scripts/ references/ assets/. Progressive disclosure:
    ~100 tokens of metadata into system prompt, full instructions loaded on demand.
  * Fetched once per session; persist on disk across invocations; re-fetched on new VM.

harness-environment: AUDITED 2026-09-25. [2 FINDINGS REPORTED] Literal facts:
  * InvokeAgentRuntimeCommand = direct shell on the harness microVM. "no model reasoning,
    no token cost, no ambiguity." *** Runs as ROOT (uid 0). *** Dockerfile USER directive
    "applies to the agent process only"; this API "runs at a higher privilege level."
    AWS: "the IAM permission is the access gate, not the in-VM privilege level."
    Stream shape: chunk.contentDelta.stdout/.stderr, chunk.contentStop.exitCode.
    Documented uses incl. clone repo, install deps, run tests, COMMIT AND PUSH,
    extract build artifacts, install skills.
    Base env = Python + bash only; git/node must be apt-get installed.
  * THREE FILESYSTEM TYPES (filesystemConfigurations), all mount under /mnt:
      sessionStorage    — service-managed, per-runtimeSessionId, survives stop/resume, no VPC
      efsAccessPoint    — BYO EFS, "shared across sessions and agents", max 2, VPC REQUIRED
      s3FilesAccessPoint— BYO S3 Files, BIDIRECTIONAL SYNC with bucket, max 2, VPC REQUIRED
    *** UpdateHarness REPLACES the entire filesystemConfigurations list — GetHarness first. ***
  * Custom container: --environment-artifact containerConfiguration.containerUri (ECR).
    linux/arm64 only. Harness OVERRIDES the image ENTRYPOINT and CMD — the container's
    startup command is NOT executed; background processes must be started via
    InvokeAgentRuntimeCommand.
  * environmentVariables map passed to the runtime container, visible to agent + container.

harness-memory: AUDITED 2026-09-25. [2 FINDINGS REPORTED] Literal facts:
  * Scoping: memory events scoped by actorId + sessionId. *** actorId is a CALLER-SUPPLIED
    field on InvokeHarness. *** Long-term retrieval templates it into the namespace path,
    e.g. /summary/{actorId}/{sessionId}/ .
  * Retrieval is AUTOMATIC on every invocation, defaults topK=10 relevanceScore=0.2,
    injected into context BEFORE the model reasons. retrievalConfig override disables
    auto-derivation.
  * *** Service API + memory omitted => service PROVISIONS MANAGED MEMORY. *** The
    AgentCore CLI defaults the other way (disabled unless selected).
  * Managed memory cannot be deleted via Memory APIs. DeleteHarness CASCADE-DELETES it by
    default; deleteManagedMemory=false disassociates instead. UpdateHarness can switch to
    BYO (agentCoreMemoryConfiguration) or disabled.
  * BYO memory can be SHARED ACROSS MULTIPLE HARNESSES (that is a stated reason to use BYO,
    along with custom namespace templates and KMS).
  * 4 long-term strategies: SEMANTIC, SUMMARIZATION, USER_PREFERENCE, EPISODIC.
  * Truncation strategies: sliding_window (default), summarization, none. Per-harness or
    per-invocation override.
  UNAUDITED harness subpages (4th carry — 3 cleared this scan, PRIORITISE harness-tools):
    harness-tools (MCP/Gateway/Browser/Code-Interpreter attachment — NEW to the list,
    referenced from pages read today), harness-command-shell (WebSocket shell API — also
    new to the list), harness-versioning, harness-export, harness-operations
